project_type: React SPA with Zustand state management, Supabase backend
build_system: Vite 6 with npm, path alias @/ -> src/
test_framework: vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, test-setup.ts for globals
test_command: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS="" npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1) Run unit tests: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS="" npx vitest run  2) Run typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck  3) Run build: cd frontend && npm run build
setup_instructions: cd frontend && npm install (already done - node_modules present)
environment_constraints: Node v22.23.2, npm available, Supabase MCP available for DB inspection. E2E tests require env vars not present - skip those. All 1144 unit tests pass at baseline.
contribution_requirements: Stores use zustand create(). Components use inline styles with CSS variables (--color-accent, --color-ink-primary, etc). Tests mock @/lib/supabase. Data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
key_patterns: Stores: zustand with separate State/Actions/Store types. Supabase queries via fromTable() helper. Components: functional with useEffect for data fetching on mount. Test files co-located in __tests__/ dirs. Templates have status DRAFT/ACTIVE/RETIRED. Design families in design_family_master table. ProjectCreation flow: BROWSE_TEMPLATES -> PROJECT_DETAILS -> CREATING -> CREATED.
directory_structure: frontend/src/ -> App.tsx (root), components/ (feature folders with __tests__), stores/ (zustand stores with __tests__), types/database.ts, lib/supabase.ts, pages/ (route pages), canvas/ (Konva canvas). Build config in frontend/vite.config.ts.
